actors.label: CONTROL
actors.purpose: Active super_admin control, except approved same-role foreign-UID case; restored afterwards

account_reuse_rule: Reuse only same UUID proven in an approved prior synthetic manifest on the same staging project; unknown existing account/email is STOP, never auto update/delete/upsert
notes: Minimum two distinct real Auth UIDs for known-existing foreign row checks; anonymous is not another account.
Separate real JWT sessions per identity; verify server-returned UID before role tests.
No credentials/JWT/password/email in this tracked template; use private provisioning ledger.
SQL dry-run restores app fixture state with ROLLBACK; external Auth provisioning is not rolled back.
Nine static accounts are an alternative only if serial fixture state transitions are unacceptable; ten not required for A.
